## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Chén-period meditation manual by **Huìsī** 慧思 (515–577), the second Tiāntái patriarch, on the *suízìyì sānmèi* 隨自意三昧 ("self-following *samādhi*") — a meditative practice that Huìsī articulated alongside the *Fǎhuá sānmèi* and the *Wúzhèng sānmèi*.

**Abstract**

The *Suízìyì sānmèi* belongs together with Huìsī's other major surviving works ([KR6d0151](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0151), [KR6d0152](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0152), [KR6d0156](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0156)) as the documentary record of his pre-Zhìyǐ Sinitic Mahāyāna meditative-doctrinal synthesis. The composition is bracketed within Huìsī's productive period at Nányuè 南嶽 c. 560–577.
